# Synthetic Data Notice

**The records generated by this project are completely synthetic.** Real public reference data is used only to set parameters and seeds, always with its source. 340B means the drug discount program created by section 340B of the Public Health Service Act.

## Nothing here describes a real organization or person

Every actor whose behavior is simulated is fictional, including covered entities, pharmacies, prescribers, patients and wholesalers. They carry sequential identifiers such as `Hospital PA001` or `SYN-DSH-PA001` (DSH for disproportionate share hospital, PA for Pennsylvania). Again, no flag, scenario or figure in this repository refers to a real hospital, clinic, pharmacy, prescriber or patient.

Synthetic identifiers are built so they cannot equal real ones.

- **National Provider Identifiers (NPIs)** pass the NPI check digit and start with 2. Every one of the 9,891,116 NPIs in the November 2026 file of the National Plan and Provider Enumeration System (NPPES), deactivated ones included, starts with 1. The audit also compares every synthetic NPI with that file, with 0 matches.
- **Fictional 11-digit National Drug Codes (NDC-11s)** for the supporting drugs use labeler codes that no real labeler uses. They were checked against 617,235 real NDC-11s in the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) listed and excluded files, the Medicaid Drug Rebate Program (MDRP) product file, the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) selected drug list and the State Drug Utilization Data (SDUD) 2025, with 0 matches.
- **Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA) format numbers** in the electronic data interchange (EDI) files fail the DEA check digit on purpose, so none can be a real registration.
- **Bank Identification Number (BIN) and Processor Control Number (PCN) values** are random fictional codes. No complete public BIN list exists to check them against, so a coincidental match with a real processor's BIN cannot be ruled out; a BIN identifies a claims processor, not a person or provider. The Pilot cash value 999999 is never used as a plan BIN.
- **340B identifiers (IDs), prescription (Rx) numbers, claim, order and patient IDs** use synthetic patterns (`SYN-...`, `PT...`) that real systems do not issue.

## What is real

Drug names, NDC-11 codes of the drugs with a Maximum Fair Price (MFP), manufacturer names, published MFPs and list prices, FDA orphan designations, state codes, state Medicaid 340B policies, Health Resources and Services Administration (HRSA) Pilot rules and the published content of the approved manufacturer Pilot plans are real public facts. Each one is taken from a cited source (see [docs/REFERENCES.md](docs/REFERENCES.md)), and seed files carry the source in their own columns. Calibration targets (shares and rates from the Office of Pharmacy Affairs Information System (OPAIS), the Medicaid Exclusion File (MEF), SDUD and published studies) are aggregates only.

## Prices

Prices are shown in US dollars so the engine can be demonstrated end to end. **They are a proof of concept and do not reflect market prices!**

**Already set by public sources**
- MFPs, as published by CMS (references CMS 2024a and CMS 2026c in docs/REFERENCES.md).
- The 2023 list price (Wholesale Acquisition Cost (WAC) per 30-day supply) of each of the 25 real drugs, set by its manufacturer and published by CMS (CMS 2024a, CMS 2025b). It is used only as the starting point of the price series.

**What is completely synthetic** is every other price and amount. That includes WAC after the starting point, Average Manufacturer Price (AMP), unit rebate amounts, 340B ceiling prices, wholesaler contract prices, chargebacks, Pilot rebates, Medicare Transaction Facilitator (MTF) refunds and Medicaid rebates. None of these reflects what any manufacturer charges, reports or pays. Real 340B ceiling prices do not appear here. Volumes, payer mixes and scenario rates are synthetic parameters calibrated only to published proportions, each tagged with its source in [config/generator.yml](config/generator.yml).

## No comparison with real-world estimates

The synthetic results are not estimates of real duplicate discounts! They exist to show how detection works and to measure it against planted ground truth. **They are not comparable to industry estimates such as IQVIA (2026), Berkeley Research Group (2024, 2025) or Kalderos (2021, 2022).**

## Neutrality

340B is the subject of an active policy and legal debate between covered entities and manufacturers. This project takes no side. Duplicate discounts are prohibited by statute, and both covered entities and manufacturers have an interest in finding them. The engine documents the evidence and does not assign responsibility.
